decision: ADOPT EXACT ORDINARY SOURCE6 PUBLIC TRANSFER INTERFACE

decisionVotes.reason: Gating `--emit-source6-transfer` behind the non-default `source6-expansion` feature (activating `mori-source6/source6-transfer-slice`) cleanly isolates the transfer-only Source/6 consumer from default `moriarty-core/1` `mori expand` and the Node beta package, returns `mori::command::source6-unavailable` before any file I/O when disabled, and scopes CLI help to the flag without marking default Core expansion unavailable. Remains unadopted until two substantive agreeing votes are recorded.

Reusing `moriarty-local-scenario/1` (`local-stipulation`) with canonical decimal `UInt` decoding and `[owner, recipient, fee_recipient]` balance ordering avoids inventing a parallel wire format while explicitly classifying missing/foreign profile or kind (`source6-scenario-profile`), unsupported `obligation`/`candidate_effects` fields (`source6-scenario-unsupported`), non-three balance arrays (`source6-scenario-cells`), remaining DTO schema errors (`source6-scenario-shape`), and source-vs-scenario cell mismatches (`mori::source6::scenario_shape`).

Emitting raw generated Source/6 text with a single trailing newline on stdout, printing `Expanded Source/6 transfer proposal (local-stipulation-only)` on non-quiet stderr, suppressing stderr under `--quiet`, and writing no stdout bytes on failure provides a clean CLI contract that preserves `local-stipulation-only` qualification without claiming Node `BetaExpansion` JSON parity or Core/5 preparation.

Splitting `mori-source6` into `select_transfer` (owning validated private `Terms` after real `mori-parser` and `mori-checker` acceptance plus `LocalS0` transfer selection) and `SelectedTransfer::expand` (with `expand_transfer` delegating to both) repairs CLI precedence so source syntax/checker errors, `mori::source6::unknown_action`, and `mori::source6::unsupported_operation` (repay/family) win before any scenario file read, while relying on existing lexer/checker invariants for `.id`/agreement lexical and reserved-word rules, distinct same-domain transfer accounts, `scale <= 18`, and `rounds` `from <= to`.

Exposing --emit-source6-transfer on mori expand behind non-default source6-expansion (forwarding to mori-source6/source6-transfer-slice) keeps default Core expand and Node beta unchanged, avoids marking default expand unavailable in CLI help, and returns mori::command::source6-unavailable before file I/O when disabled. Suitable for adoption pending root's two substantive agreeing votes.

Reusing moriarty-local-scenario/1 and local-stipulation for the closed transfer subset with mori_core::UInt canonical decimal decoding and 3 ordered balances [owner, recipient, fee_recipient] is well-scoped; read_scenario checks profile/kind (source6-scenario-profile), obligation/candidate_effects (source6-scenario-unsupported), and balance count != 3 (source6-scenario-cells) after strict JSON parsing and before serde DTO decoding (source6-scenario-shape) and SelectedTransfer::expand cell validation (mori::source6::scenario_shape). Suitable for adoption pending root's two substantive agreeing votes.

Writing raw Source/6 proposal text with its single trailing newline to stdout and reporting Expanded Source/6 transfer proposal (local-stipulation-only) on stderr (suppressed by --quiet, with empty stdout on failure) truthfully reflects the local-stipulation-only proposal boundary without claiming Core/5 preparation or Node JSON wrapper parity. Suitable for adoption pending root's two substantive agreeing votes.

Factoring mori_source6::select_transfer -> SelectedTransfer::expand (with expand_transfer delegating to both) and invoking select_transfer in crates/mori/src/commands/expand/source6.rs before read_scenario ensures source parse/check diagnostics, mori::source6::unknown_action, and mori::source6::unsupported_operation (for repay and SpecifiedOnly family actions) win before scenario file I/O. Routine conformance repair requiring no new feature vote.

scope: Optional source6-expansion explicit --emit-source6-transfer; closed existing local scenario transfer subset; raw Source6 stdout/local-stipulation-only status; real source/action selection before scenario I/O
